text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to the cafeteria, I found Ines 
Fujin surrounded by a massive pile of 
taiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Ehehe, I'm having a solo 
taiyaki party right now♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, so at the taiyaki shop I worked at 
today—

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Shoot. I ordered way too many 
ingredients by mistake.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh boy... But a pinch is a chance! We'll 
use those ingredients to teach all the 
part-timers the manager's special grilling 
technique!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"It keeps the ingredients from going to 
waste, and it's great practice for my 
part-time job, so it kills two birds with 
one stone!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, I got a whole bunch of taiyaki 
they made for practice!”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to pack plenty of red bean 
paste into all of them~♪ Well then, time 
to dig in~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Ines Fujin happily reached for 
a taiyaki.
choice_data_list:
Eat a lot to make up for all your hard 
work.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh. Y-Yeah, this really is too much. 
There's so much red bean paste, too...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Since I baked them myself, I wanted to eat 
them for you, but I have to know my 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, these are for handing out to 
everyone! I'm gonna throw a taiyaki party 
with everybody!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, everyone~! Listen up~! These 
delicious taiyaki are actually free, today 
only~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'll tell you where the taiyaki shop 
is, so if it's tasty, you should go check 
it out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, many students became regulars 
at the taiyaki stand.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Since I made it myself, it has 
sentimental value, which makes it twice as 
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu~, I've gotten way better at making 
taiyaki, plus I get to eat until I'm full, 
so happy~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Ines Fujin happily devoured 
the entire taiyaki.
